correctness.rationale: The witness equivalence is correct: for each new two-set e, a previous-edge hitting set of size at most 2 avoiding e gives a new open-neighborhood witness, with padding possible since n>=5. Exterior-square Vandermonde independence proves the six-term upper bound, and the six two-subsets of a four-set achieve it. Independently wrote the first-appearance recursive enumerator (including singleton covers and two-new-label orientation factors). It exhausts 2,200 legal six-edge patterns and exactly reproduces the 13 (support, simultaneous-introduction) histogram entries and all binomial coefficients 720,33120,257040,655200,624960,181440 at supports 4..9. This finite classification is exhaustive for arbitrary n because only 12 endpoint positions are involved, not empirical polynomial interpolation.
